summary: Completed comprehensive testing of donation invoice feature (Phase 'Facture de don pirate'). All backend APIs working correctly with FR/EN support. Frontend admin panel and donations page fully functional with receipt_id generation, invoice download (PDF/XLSX × FR/EN), and public receipt recovery.
